distortions.what: Source gives distinct LO (-10%, macro/semis) and HF (-8%, software shorts) sell figures; brief compresses to 'Both LOs and HFs are net sellers today,' dropping the percentages and sector detail.

distortions.would_the_trade_change: No — the 1.2% decline and all three headlines are accurately reported; only the causal attribution among co-occurring headlines is tightened.

distortions.what: Brief attributes 'echoes of Warsh' to Barkin's speech specifically; in the source, Barkin's remarks are described on their own terms, and the 'echoing Warsh's press conference' language belongs to a separate Fri/Sun Fedspeak item in the weekly-outlook section.
